# Fallout 76 patch notes "Glow of the Ghoul" on March 18, 2025 (Patch 58)

![Fallout 76 patch notes `Glow of the Ghoul` on March 18th, 2025 (Patch 58)](/uploads/477_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

# Fallout 76: The Ghoul Within – Update Notes

March 18, 2025

Unleash your inner ghoul. With today's Inner Ghoul update, Wastelanders can leave their humanity behind and play as a ghoul. Experience Appalachia in a whole new way.
### No fear. Step into the radiation and come out as a ghoul!

Today's Inner Ghoul update gives all Wastelanders the opportunity to transform into a Ghoul and experience Appalachia in a whole new way, with new gameplay mechanics and exclusive Ghoul Skill Cards. Hopefully you're ready to unleash your inner Ghoul!

### Update highlights

**Ghulification**: Head “into the unknown” in a new section of the Savage Divide and transform into a full-fledged ghoul!
**Exclusive Ghoul Skill Cards**: Open up ghoul-tastic build possibilities with 30 new skill cards (28 normal and 2 legendary).
**Season 20: Ghoul's Shine**: Mutation. Radiation. SHINE. It's time to ghoulize Appalachia!

## Update version 1.7.18.22 and download sizes

**PC (Steam)**: 18.9 GB
**PC (Microsoft Store)**: 37.6 GB
**Xbox**: 37.6GB
**PlayStation**: 36.8GB

## Ghoulification

To begin your life as a ghoul, you must start the quest series “Into the Unknown,” which will take you to a new section of the Savage Divide. There you will meet characters who will help you with your transformation. By completing this quest line, you will also complete your transformation, which unlocks the new exclusive ghoul abilities "Glow" and "Feral" and grants access to 30 new ghoul-exclusive skills.
### Ghoul Abilities

**Wilding**Becoming a ghoul means you no longer have to satisfy your hunger and thirst. Instead, you fight the nagging desire to revert back to your basic nature and lose all sanity. The new feral gauge depletes over time and can only be refilled with chems, although filling it to 100 percent is not advisable. Your Feral status gives you various bonuses and penalties based on how full the gauge is. - Above 80%: You gain +3 Strength, +3 Stamina and +30 Max HP. - Above 60%: You gain +15 max HP. - Over 40%: You lose 1 stamina and 5 max HP. - Over 20%: You lose 3 stamina, 15 max HP. and 10 max. AP. - At 0%: You gain +150% melee damage and lose 5 Stamina, 99 Charisma, 30 max HP, 20 max AP, and 300% Accuracy and V.A.T.S. Accuracy.**Glow**As you might expect when living as a ghoul, radiation does not affect you in the same way it does the typical smooth skin. You are immune to diseases and cannot mutate due to radiation in the environment. On the contrary, as a ghoul, radiation makes you glow! This new glow system increases your maximum health (and heals any damage you take) based on the amount of radiation you collect. You can keep track of your glow using the green striped pattern on the HP bar. Consuming contaminated food or drinks and exploring contaminated environments contribute to your glow. If you hear the Pip-Boy ticking, radiation is present. In Power Armor, you can see your radiation intake on the “Rads” scale next to your health. In addition to increasing your maximum health through glowing, it also contributes to the “Science Monster” and “Fast as a Cheetah” skills mentioned below!
### Ghoul Skills

One of the immediate benefits of living as a ghoul is access to a new set of skill cards that you can use alongside your normal ones
